item.description: Countdown to Valentine’s Day — and, more importantly, the annual Homer Winter Carnival Parade! The chamber is looking for volunteers...

item.title: Pet of the Week: First Friday Foster Night
item.description: Learn what fostering looks like and the support we provide, all in a no-pressure setting.

item.title: Council moves forward with Hornaday Park trail
item.description: The Homer City Council passed a resolution last week to seek proposals for planning and design of a loop trail above Karen Hornaday Park.

item.title: Kenai man sentenced for sexual abuse charges
item.description: Ollie Garrett, 62, will serve 15 years in prison for sexual abuse of a minor.

item.title: Calderwood pleads guilty to murder of Homer woman
item.description: Kirby Calderwood pleaded guilty to the 2019 murder of Anesha “Duffy” Murnane on Feb. 5, four years after his arrest in 2022.

item.title: Search and rescue group members receive certification
item.description: The initial cohort of a Homer-based search and rescue group recently completed a hands-on, nationally-certified training session.

item.title: Ruffridge, Elam introduce new legislative bills
item.description: The representatives filed bills relating to tax exemptions for EMS personnel and dental care.

item.title: Juneau bill aims to stabilize education funding
item.description: House Bill 261 would change how schools rely on student counts.

item.title: Assembly addresses formal presentations in code amendment
item.description: An ordinance passed Feb. 3 clarifies that formal presentations made before the Kenai Peninsula Borough Assembly should relate to borough matters.
